mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decrease in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production signals a slowing economy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of industrial production decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong personal consumption growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate and a decrease in consumer price index signals a monetary policy response to inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of monetary policy response to inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate above 6% signals a weakening labor market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP and a decrease in housing starts signals a shift in economic growth drivers, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of shifting economic growth drivers (t-test p > 0.05).
